items.colloc: file a complaint 提出投訴 | resolve a complaint 解決投訴
items.distinct: grievance 不滿；申訴 | criticism 批評
ex: The customer filed a formal complaint yesterday.
該客戶昨天正式提出投訴。
We received a complaint about the service.
我們收到關於服務的投訴。
Management will address every customer complaint.
管理層將處理每一項客戶投訴。

items.colloc: remain courteous 保持禮貌 | courteous staff 有禮的員工
items.distinct: polite 有禮貌的 | considerate 體貼的
ex: Our staff always remains courteous to clients.
我們的員工對客戶始終保持禮貌。
Please be courteous during the phone call.
請在通話期間保持禮貌。
He provided courteous service to all visitors.
他為所有訪客提供了客氣的服務。

items.colloc: make an enquiry 進行查詢 | handle an enquiry 處理詢問
items.distinct: question 問題 | request 要求
ex: The clerk handles every enquiry with patience.
店員耐心處理每一項查詢。
Please direct your enquiry to the desk.
請將您的詢問導向服務櫃台。
We received an enquiry about product pricing.
我們收到關於產品定價的詢問。

items.colloc: ensure satisfaction 確保滿意 | guarantee satisfaction 保證滿意
items.distinct: contentment 滿足感 | fulfillment 成就感
ex: Customer satisfaction is our top priority now.
客戶滿意度是我們現在的首要目標。
We guarantee your satisfaction with the purchase.
我們保證您對此次購買感到滿意。
The team aims for complete customer satisfaction.
團隊致力於達成完全的客戶滿意。

items.pos: adj. 反應迅速的；熱情的
items.colloc: highly responsive 反應極快的 | remain responsive 保持回應
items.distinct: responsible 負責任的 | reactive 反應性的
ex: The support team is very responsive today.
支援團隊今天反應非常迅速。
We need a more responsive service department.
我們需要反應更迅速的服務部門。
They are responsive to all user feedback.
他們對所有用戶回饋都反應迅速。

items.colloc: polite request 禮貌的請求 | polite manner 禮貌的態度
items.distinct: courteous 彬彬有禮的 | respectful 尊敬的
ex: It is polite to greet the visitor.
向訪客打招呼是有禮貌的。
She gave a polite response to him.
她給了他一個有禮貌的回應。
Always maintain a polite tone when speaking.
說話時務必保持有禮的語氣。

items.colloc: resolve an issue 解決問題 | resolve a dispute 解決爭議
items.distinct: solve 處理數學或具體問題 | settle 協議解決
ex: We need to resolve this issue immediately.
我們需要立即解決這個問題。
The technician helped resolve the technical glitch.
技師協助解決了技術故障。
They managed to resolve the customer dispute.
他們設法解決了客戶爭議。

items.colloc: have patience 具備耐心 | test one's patience 考驗某人的耐心
items.distinct: endurance 忍耐力 | tolerance 寬容
ex: Dealing with clients requires great patience.
處理客戶問題需要極大的耐心。
Thank you for your patience during delays.
感謝您在延遲期間的耐心等待。
She showed patience when explaining the policy.
她在解釋政策時展現了耐心。

items.colloc: offer a solution 提供方案 | seek a solution 尋求解答
items.distinct: answer 答案 | method 方法
ex: We are looking for a permanent solution.
我們正在尋找永久的解決方案。
The manager proposed an effective solution today.
經理今天提出了一個有效的方案。
This software provides the best solution available.
這款軟體提供了目前最好的解決方案。

items.colloc: sales representative 銷售代表 | customer representative 客服代表
items.distinct: delegate 代表（授權參加會議者） | agent 代理商
ex: A representative will contact you very soon.
代表很快會與您聯繫。
The company sent a representative to help.
公司派了一位代表來幫忙。
Ask to speak with a customer representative.
請求與客服代表通話。

items.colloc: provide assistance 提供協助 | seek assistance 尋求協助
items.distinct: aid 幫助；救助 | support 支援
ex: Please contact us if you need assistance.
如果您需要協助請聯繫我們。
The team provides technical assistance for users.
團隊為用戶提供技術協助。
We require additional assistance for this task.
這項任務我們需要額外的協助。

items.colloc: cause an inconvenience 造成不便 | regret the inconvenience 對造成的不便感到抱歉
items.distinct: trouble 麻煩 | annoyance 惱怒
ex: We apologize for any inconvenience caused here.
我們對此處造成的不便深感抱歉。
The construction caused some inconvenience to guests.
施工對房客造成了一些不便。
We try to minimize any potential inconvenience.
我們嘗試將潛在的不便減到最低。

items.colloc: act promptly 立即採取行動 | respond promptly 即刻回應
items.distinct: immediately 立即 | punctually 準時地
ex: The team will respond to emails promptly.
團隊將會立即回應電子郵件。
Please complete the forms and return promptly.
請填寫表格並立即歸還。
Staff members arrived at the meeting promptly.
員工們準時到達了會議。

items.colloc: troubleshoot a problem 排除問題 | troubleshoot an error 解決錯誤
items.distinct: repair 修理 | fix 修復
ex: The technician tried to troubleshoot the device.
技師嘗試對該設備進行故障排除。
He knows how to troubleshoot common issues.
他知道如何排除常見的問題。
We need time to troubleshoot the system.
我們需要時間來對系統進行檢修。

items.colloc: exceed expectations 超出預期 | exceed the budget 超出預算
items.distinct: surpass 勝過 | excel 優於
ex: The service will exceed your expectations today.
這項服務今天將超出您的預期。
Do not let the expenses exceed the budget.
不要讓費用超出預算。
They often exceed their monthly sales targets.
他們經常超出每月的銷售目標。

items.colloc: company policy 公司政策 | refund policy 退款政策
items.distinct: strategy 策略 | procedure 程序
ex: The company changed its return policy recently.
公司最近更改了退貨政策。
Please review our privacy policy carefully today.
請今天仔細閱讀我們的隱私政策。
Strict policy prevents unauthorized system access.
嚴格的政策防止未經授權的系統存取。

items.colloc: work diligently 勤奮工作 | study diligently 認真學習
items.distinct: carefully 小心地 | actively 主動地
ex: The staff worked diligently on the project.
員工們為該專案勤奮工作。
She prepared the report quite diligently today.
她今天非常用心地準備報告。
We searched diligently for the missing files.
我們勤奮地尋找遺失的檔案。

items.colloc: formal inquiry 正式調查 | handle an inquiry 處理詢問
items.distinct: query 疑問 | research 研究
ex: The company launched an inquiry into complaints.
公司針對投訴展開了一項調查。
Please forward the inquiry to the manager.
請將這項詢問轉寄給經理。
We are processing every inquiry in order.
我們正按順序處理每一項詢問。

items.colloc: show dedication 展現奉獻 | full dedication 全力投入
items.distinct: commitment 承諾 | devotion 熱愛
ex: Her dedication to customers is truly impressive.
她對客戶的奉獻令人印象深刻。
The project requires total dedication from staff.
該專案需要員工們的全心投入。
He shows great dedication to his daily work.
他對日常工作展現了極大的專注。

items.colloc: complimentary breakfast 免費早餐 | complimentary drink 免費飲料
items.distinct: free 免費的 | optional 選配的
ex: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast daily.
飯店每天提供免費早餐。
Guests receive a complimentary drink upon arrival.
客人在抵達時會收到一杯免費飲料。
The service includes a complimentary shuttle bus.
這項服務包含免費接駁車。
